hero.title: Operate your virtual machines
hero.subtitle: AstraHive connects to your virtual machines over SSH so you can run maintenance operations, group machines into clusters and schedule recurring tasks without juggling terminals.
hero.imageAlt: A hive of virtual machines linked across a network

features.label: Capabilities
features.title: Everything a maintenance window needs
features.subtitle: One place to reach your fleet, act on it and keep it healthy.

ssh.title: SSH operations
ssh.text: Open sessions to any registered machine and run maintenance commands: updates, restarts, log collection, disk cleanup.

clusters.title: Clusters
clusters.text: Group virtual machines into clusters and run the same operation across all of them in a single step.

tasks.title: Scheduled tasks
tasks.text: Define recurring tasks once and let AstraHive execute them on schedule against a machine or a whole cluster.

audit.title: Run history
audit.text: Every operation is recorded with its target, output and exit status, so you always know what changed and when.

step1.title: Register machines
step1.text: Add your virtual machines with their SSH endpoints and credentials.

step2.title: Group into clusters
step2.text: Organize machines by environment, role or location.

step3.title: Run or schedule
step3.text: Execute operations now or put them on a recurring schedule.

cta.title: Ready to take control of your fleet?
cta.text: Sign in to the console to start managing your virtual machines.
